attempted_parameters.prompt:
One final targeted imagegen revision of reference 1 (previous portrait), keeping exactly the SAME identity, age, hair color, outfit colors and face. Reference 2 is the original identity master. References 3–6 give STYLE ONLY. This is a close face-only medieval pixel-art portrait designed on 74x100 pixels, transparent background. Make these concrete corrections:
1. REDESIGN COMPOSITION TO REMOVE THE LONG NECK. Huge close head and face from near y=4 to chin at about y=88 of the final 100-pixel height; a tiny 3–4 pixel natural neck sliver then only 5–6 pixels of narrow clothing collar. No upper chest, no collarbone, no torso triangle. Enlarge head vertically within the composition without stretching or slimming facial anatomy. Do not merely raise shoulders around an unchanged neck. Do not add scarves or a high collar, do not crop the head. Face itself should command the canvas; retain 2–3 pixels real transparent safety margin around every hair/headscarf/ear edge.
2. EYES: very narrow dark eyes, solid clearly readable dark iris/pupil clusters, small dull warm-gray sclera limited to at most a single small side pixel per eye at target size. The previous bright white blocks must disappear. Eyelids and solid pupils dominate; no white glints or catchlights.
3. Genuinely coarse pixel clusters like four style references: broad connected nose and cheekbone planes, 3–4 large skin tones with stepped transitions, fewer connected hair masses. No smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no dithering, no high-frequency fine strands, no checker noise. Temporary total palette no more than32 visible colors; strong low-resolution readability.
Luling is a woman in her forties. Preserve the broad cheeks, thick broad lower jaw, long broad nose, full flat lips, pale tied linen headscarf, neat center-parted dark brown hair, charcoal coat and muted ochre inner collar. Keep the whole headscarf including back knot with real transparent side margin, particularly on the right. Remove dangling curls at both temples; the source has neatly tucked side hair. Relax the corrugated angry brow: low calm lids, only a tiny single-brow lift, shrewd and guarded but fair, NOT a villain or angry bully. Retain age planes without harsh angry furrows. Keep the mouth quietly closed, no forced gold-tooth grin.
Transparent RGBA output only, full portrait contained, no text, frames, swatch boards, props, hands or background. Preserve the approved identity rather than copying a style person's face.
